item.title: NVIDIA Enlists Wall Street to Mobilize $500 Billion for AI Factory Compute
item.summary: NVIDIA partnered with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure, framing GPU-based compute as a new investable asset class with rising rental economics and decade-long hardware lifespans.
